schoolgate.ai: A small girl in a red school uniform stands alone at an empty school gate in grey afternoon light, Papa walking toward her from behind, wide shot
Papa kneels and hugs the small girl at the school gate, shot from behind Papa, the girl's pale hands on his shirt, cold teal light
Close shot of the girl's pale face in shadow beside Papa's ear, she is whispering, school gate blurred behind
Papa standing at the gate reading a phone screen, his worried face lit blue by the phone, dusk
Anaya, a sick girl, asleep in her bed at home under a blanket, warm lamp, a thermometer on the nightstand, wide shot
Papa holding the girl in his arms at the gate, the girl's head over his shoulder smiling too wide at the camera, her eyes reflecting light, dusk

chair-p1.ai: An old wooden rocking chair in a dark living room at night, a tall thin shadow sitting in it facing the window, wide shot, cold moonlight
A hospital bed at night with an old man sitting up screaming, a phone glowing on the blanket, a nurse rushing in from the corridor, dim green light
chair-p1.motion: the old man's head turns slowly toward camera

chair-p2.ai: A pale old man in a white kurta sitting in a wooden rocking chair in a dark living room, a boy watching from the doorway, seen from behind the boy, warm dim lamp
Behind a rocking chair in a dark room a tall thin shadow bends over the sitting old man, smiling, moonlight through curtains, wide shot
chair-p2.motion: the rocking chair slowly rocks and the shadow leans closer
